levels.surface: أمية بن صفوان بن عبد الله بن صفوان

notes: «سمع جده عبد الله بن صفوان»: جده plus a name is one link, surface the name alone (rule 7)
Hafsa is the Companion who reports the Prophet's words; «فقال رجل» in the later scene is not a link
K6I and HKG differ on Umayya's patronymic; the text's words are followed
